name: Samosa & Company
emailSource: Listed in header section of official website samosa.com.br
notes: Authentic Indian restaurant by chef Deepali Bavaskar. Located at Alameda Jaú, 1639, Jardins. One of the few dedicated Indian cuisine restaurants in São Paulo. Open Tue–Sun for lunch and dinner.

name: Tandoor
emailSource: Listed in footer under Fale Conosco on official website tandoor.com.br
notes: One of the oldest Indian restaurants in São Paulo, operating since 1990. Located at Rua Mário Amaral, 559, Paraíso. Menu of 70+ dishes including tandoori specialties, curries, naan and samosa. An SP institution for Indian cuisine.

name: Brasserie Victória
notes: Founded in 1947, this is São Paulo's most iconic Arab cuisine institution. Located at Av. Presidente Juscelino Kubitschek, 545, Itaim Bibi. Michelin Bib Gourmand recognized. Buffet and à la carte with kibbe, tabule, kafta and grape leaf wraps.

name: Ecully
emailSource: Listed in contact section of official website ecully.com.br (confirmed via Solutudo directory listing showing contact@ecully.com.br)
notes: Michelin Bib Gourmand 2025. Run by chefs Juliana and Guilherme (a couple who met in the French town of Écully), blending Brazilian, French and Italian influences. Located at Rua Cotoxó, 493, Pompeia. Charming courtyard, outdoor tables surrounded by greenery. Excellent value creative cuisine.

name: Graça di Napolli
emailSource: Listed explicitly in the Reservations / Fale Conosco section of official website gracadinapolli.com.br
notes: Elected Best Pizzeria in Brazil by Premio Gula 2015 and Best Pizzeria in São Paulo by Veja SP Comer & Beber 2014-2015. Located at Rua Dr. César, 704, Santana. Premium Neapolitan pizza with long-fermentation dough and high-end Italian ingredients.

name: Pizzaria Speranza – Bixiga
emailSource: Listed in the Fale Conosco section of official website pizzaria.com.br for the Bixiga unit
notes: Iconic São Paulo pizzeria founded in 1956, located at R. 13 de Maio, 1004, Bela Vista (Bixiga). One of the oldest and most awarded pizzerias in SP. Credited with introducing Margherita pizza to Brazil. Also operates a Moema unit (speranza.moema@pizzaria.com.br).

name: Pizzaria Speranza – Moema
emailSource: Listed in the Fale Conosco section of official website pizzaria.com.br for the Moema unit
notes: Second unit of the legendary Pizzaria Speranza, opened in Moema in 1979. Located at Av. Sabiá, 786, Moema. Same award-winning Neapolitan-style Margherita and mozzarella pizzas. Moema neighborhood is underserved in our outreach.

name: Rubi Wine Bar
emailSource: Confirmed official contact email from business listing (cnpj.biz and rubiwinebar.com.br domain)
notes: Established wine bar open since 2011. Main location at Alameda Jaú, 1595, Jardins, with a second unit at Praça Franklin Roosevelt, 92, Consolação. Over 80 wine labels by the glass and bottle. Extensive food program for pairing. Two-unit presence covering Jardins and Consolação.

name: Vinoteca Paulistana
emailSource: Standard pattern for confirmed official domain vinotecapaulistana.com.br — verify by calling (11) 2305-3471 before sending
notes: Gastronomy-focused wine bar and enoteca in Perdizes / Vila Pompeia. Located at Rua Ministro Ferreira Alves, 54, Perdizes. Wine at importer prices, strong lunch and dinner food program. Active site with reservation system. Perdizes is an underserved neighborhood in our outreach.

name: The Kith
emailSource: Standard pattern for confirmed official domain thekith.com.br; restaurant has dedicated events/contact page — verify before sending
notes: Michelin Bib Gourmand 2025. Located at Av. Rebouças, 3875, 2nd floor, Pinheiros. Modern Brazilian gastronomy at excellent value with a monthly rotating menu. Strong corporate events capacity (20–200 guests). Open Mon–Sat for lunch.

name: Cepa
emailSource: Best-guess domain based on brand name; CNPJ 32147546000166 (Cepa Restaurante LTDA) confirmed. Verify via (11) 2096-0687 before sending.
notes: Michelin Bib Gourmand 2025. Recently relocated from Tatuapé to Praça dos Omaguás, 110, Pinheiros. Chef Lucas Dante uses smoking, maturing and fermenting techniques with seasonal ingredients. Sommelier Gabrielli Fleming curates biodynamic and organic wines. One of SP's hottest restaurants in 2025.

name: Zena Cucina
emailSource: Standard pattern for confirmed official domain zenacaffe.com.br — verify via (11) 3082-9362 before sending
notes: Michelin Bib Gourmand for 7 consecutive years. Chef Carlos Bertolazzi's Italian restaurant at Rua Peixoto Gomide, 1901, Jardins. Authentic Ligurian cuisine with fresh handmade pasta and curated wine list. One of the most consistently awarded value restaurants in Brazil.

name: Kotori
emailSource: Best-guess domain based on brand; reservations handled via Tock (exploretock.com/kotori). Verify via (11) 2373-3587 before sending.
notes: Michelin Bib Gourmand 2025. Latin America's 50 Best Restaurants 2024 (#50). Chef Thiago Bañares fuses Japanese yōshoku cooking with Brazilian ingredients. Located at Rua Cônego Eugênio Leite, 639, Pinheiros. Single tasting menu format. One of SP's most critically acclaimed restaurants.

name: Cora
emailSource: Best-guess domain; CNPJ 36043515000116 (Cora Bar e Restaurante LTDA) confirmed. Primary contact is WhatsApp (11) 3231-4561 — verify before sending.
notes: Michelin Bib Gourmand 2025. Rooftop restaurant on 6th floor of Rua Amaral Gurgel, 344, Vila Buarque, with views over the Minhocão. Chef Pablo Inca (Argentine) creates seasonal Brazilian land-to-table cuisine at accessible prices. Underserved Vila Buarque / Consolação area.

name: Reet Namaste
emailSource: Standard pattern for confirmed official domain reetnamaste.com.br — website is active. Verify via (11) 4214-6057 before sending.
notes: Indian restaurant with two SP units: Jardim Paulista (Alameda Lorena, 442) and Mirandópolis. Known for authentic tandoori dishes prepared in clay ovens, with exclusive spice recipes brought directly from India. Strong repeat customer base across both SP locations.
